newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CEZ shares rise on 9mo results.
newsitem.headline: Czech CEZ shares rise on 9mo results.

text.p: Shares in Czech power utility CEZ a.s. made strong gains on Monday bolstered by generally bullish market sentiment after weekend Senate elections and its own nine month results published on Friday.
At 1100 GMT (1200 local time) CEZ had risen 14 crowns, 1.5 percent, from the open to 951 putting the issue 43 crowns above its 12 month low of 908 which it hit last Wednesday.
"The (financial) results are definitely helping the price..they were seen as quite positive by the market," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.

CEZ rose 14 crowns to 937 on Friday after posting nine month net profits of 8.4 billion crowns versus 7.4 billion in the same period in 1995. The figures were calculated according to international accounting standards.
In Czech accounting, net profits rose to seven billion crowns from 6.7 billion.
Referring to the market as a whole Vystavel said:
"It is quite likely that this (upsurge) is the start of a trend...We had expected some speculation on the outcome of the elections."

At Monday's price fixing, the PX50 index rose 2.1 percent to 496.8. Dealers said the rise was caused by the strong showing of Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus's Civic Democratic Party (ODS) in the first round of Senate elections at the weekend.
